title: Yeasty Springy Kashmiri Lamb Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic Kashmiri lamb dish cooked in a tagine clay vessel, featuring ginger cordial and yuzu-cure for a unique taste experience. This recipe is low in calories and rich in protein.

ingredients.name: lamb shoulder
ingredients.notes: boneless and cut into 2 inch pieces

instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Heat the olive oil in the tagine clay vessel over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until they are browned on all sides.
Add the ginger cordial, yuzu juice, yeast extract, kashmiri red chili powder, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Cover the tagine clay vessel with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 2.5 hours, or until the lamb is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Remove the tagine from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
